lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are organized into approximately six distinct vertical columns between the branchial region and the first dorsal fin; centroids within these columns exhibit a repeating vertical spacing and a staggered horizontal offset between adjacent columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are aligned with the blob columns, intersecting with faint horizontal luminance axes to create a grid-like lattice where the blobs serve as primary anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring high-intensity pixels on the dorsal margin and a shadow-induced drop in intensity on the ventral margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately seven distinct, high-luminance circular blobs distributed across its lateral surface, with a higher spatial density observed toward the anterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, lower-intensity blobs compared to the primary lateral flank constellation.
